note: SendGrid publishes no per-endpoint or per-account numeric limit table. The only source of truth is the X-RateLimit-* headers at runtime. The v3 Mail Send endpoint is the one official numeric exception.

headers.X-RateLimit-Limit: requests permitted in the current refresh period
headers.X-RateLimit-Remaining: requests left in the current period
headers.X-RateLimit-Reset: epoch seconds when the period resets — absolute timestamp, not a duration

v3_mail_send.recipient_scope: to + cc + bcc across all personalizations

other_endpoints.model: fixed requests per refresh period per endpoint

429.body: errors array with message 'too many requests'
429.fix: wait until X-RateLimit-Reset epoch time, or Retry-After if present

413.fix: split attachments or send a link

400_recipient_limit.meaning: more than 1,000 recipients in one request

ip_warmup.recommendation: separate dedicated IPs for marketing and transactional

retry_guidance.primary_fix: read X-RateLimit-Reset as epoch seconds and sleep until then
retry_guidance.structural_fix: batch recipients via personalizations and use a fixed-size worker queue

escape_hatch: plan capacity against the warm-up schedule, not the 10,000 req/sec API ceiling; batch recipients and separate marketing from transactional IPs
